method.principle: Conservative DOM-order reconstruction for defensible stratified sampling; do not infer missing chapter bodies.
chapter_boundaries: inline star-prefixed chapter transitions when structurally present
method.safe_anchor_rule: 1500-5000 cleaned characters; <=4 detected contamination-pattern hits; exactly one primary chapter header; no known website-debris title; no obvious numbered split-wrapper suffix.

integrity_interpretation.early_and_mid_source: Broadly usable for source-located qualitative sampling after local contamination stripping.
integrity_interpretation.late_source: Materially degraded and sparse under conservative reconstruction; use only explicitly located safe anchors and do not extrapolate quantitative whole-book statistics.
integrity_interpretation.whole_narrative_range: Still reaches the recorded finale in the raw source, but raw reach is not equivalent to clean chapter-by-chapter reconstructability.

claims_not_authorized: final whole-book chapter-length or dialogue statistics
content imputation for missing or ambiguous chapter numbers
using contaminated late ranges as uniformly representative
next_use: Use only safe, source-located anchors for Phase385 second-pass qualitative mechanism extraction; preserve source-quality caveats in every derived claim.
